title: Prior-art delta / gap-map vs Carpentries, bioc-intro, and HBC hbctraining
context: PLAN.md v0.2 adds a prior-art delta / gap-map as an M0 exit criterion, motivated by the new Competitive landscape & differentiation section. Because high-quality adjacent OER already exists (Carpentries Data Carpentry Genomics, Bioconductor carpentries-incubator/bioc-intro, Harvard Chan hbctraining), this curriculum must argue its non-duplication concretely, not asserted. The gap-map must record: which episodes/modules are net-new (cancer-specific, Python-parity, reproducibility-by-construction); which CC-BY neighbours are candidates for fork-and-adapt; and where the curriculum's unique intersection (from-zero + cancer-specific + dual R+Python + CI-reproducible) is genuinely unoccupied. This is also the document that decides what to author fresh vs reuse under CC-BY licensing.
objective: Produce a prior-art delta / gap-map document that: surveys the three closest OER neighbours (Carpentries Data Carpentry Genomics, Bioconductor bioc-intro / carpentries-incubator, Harvard Chan hbctraining); identifies which episodes or modules may be forked-and-adapted under CC-BY vs authored fresh; maps the curriculum's net-new content (cancer framing, Python parity, CI reproducibility, zero-install path, statistical humility thread, dataset license gate as curriculum); and records the open question resolutions from PLAN.md v0.2 §Open Questions (reuse boundary, biology floor, i18n-readiness).
acceptanceCriteria: Surveys at minimum: Carpentries Data Carpentry Genomics, Bioconductor carpentries-incubator/bioc-intro, and Harvard Chan hbctraining — capturing scope, audience assumptions, language (R/Python/both), CI status, and license.
Produces a gap table mapping this curriculum's planned modules against the three neighbours, marking each as: (a) fork-and-adapt (CC-BY, cite source), (b) net-new, or (c) complementary-link.
For any fork-and-adapt candidate, records the specific source episode URL, its license (CC-BY confirmed), and the adaptation rationale (what changes to add cancer framing / Python parity / CI etc.).
Answers the prior-art reuse boundary open question (PLAN.md §Open Questions #7) and the biology prerequisite floor open question (#8) with a documented decision.
The document is committed to docs/gap-map.md and reviewed by Pedagogy reviewer; licensed CC-BY-4.0.
resources: PLAN.md v0.2 (§ Competitive landscape & differentiation, § Goals, § Scope — deliverables, § Roadmap M0 exit criteria, § Open Questions #7, #8)
